id.summary: Praktik kerja di bagian engineering hotel, dari perawatan kamar hingga pemeriksaan kondisi peralatan.
details: Melakukan perawatan preventif kamar: membersihkan AC, mengecat ulang bagian dinding yang rusak, grouting lantai, memperbaiki bagian yang rusak, dan mengaplikasikan sealant toilet.
Menangani keluhan tamu terkait kamar hotel.
Memeriksa kondisi panel hotel, chiller dan freezer, tekanan gas, serta APAR.
Melakukan perawatan area hotel saat terjadi kerusakan.

en.summary: On-the-job training in hotel engineering, from room maintenance to checking equipment conditions.
details: Carried out preventive room maintenance: cleaning air conditioners, repainting damaged wall areas, grouting floors, repairing damaged parts, and applying toilet sealant.
Handled guest complaints about hotel rooms.
Checked hotel panels, chillers and freezers, gas pressure, and fire extinguishers.
Carried out maintenance in hotel areas when damage occurred.
